subject: Kickoff: extreme-memorization diagnostics track (Feb-May)
body:
Hi Ivo, team,

Kicking off the extreme-memorization workstream under data-platforms. Goal: turn the initialization-scale findings into a training-diagnostics feature for Corpus customers — specifically, surface the representation and gradient alignment scalars our open-source release already logs to TensorBoard as an early-warning signal for memorization.

Milestones: repro on CIFAR-10 and SVHN by end of Feb; alignment-metric API draft mid-March; internal dogfood by Apr 20; launch review before May 4.

Ownership: Amara and Saoirse take the tfrecord ingestion path, Rafael the MLP/convnet sweeps, Bilal the TensorBoard plumbing. I'll send a milestone doc Friday — flag anything that makes the end-of-Feb repro unrealistic.

Thanks,
Dmitri
